title: The twenty scenarios: ten organisms, each native and with Omni-Compass on native
own_runs: Run and scored by The Omni-Compass LLC's own code. No outside party has reviewed or approved these results. Preregistered means the rules were written down in our own repository before the runs; nothing was filed with any outside body.

work.name: work
work.how: the work index: each decision, the mean over the muscles of the work each did against the reference arm's own mean rate (1.0 is the reference's own work)

over.name: muscles over the line
over.how: the muscles over their own line, counted each decision (a muscle-decision over the line is time over the line)

power.name: power
power.how: the organism's electrical draw each decision, kW, as its lines carry it (realms/harness.py Body.all_w, the reading the bone grants from); the runner's energy beside it is each plant's own metered energy with a battery's charge left below its start bought back at its round trip, so the two can move apart

spread.name: spread
spread.how: the spread of the muscles' service positions each decision (shown, never judged)

organisms.class: S (a composition of class P and class L measurements)

native.note: every factor is a ratio against native, each layer measured with its own native as its own test ran it; native carries no number of its own

composition.rule: R(g) = ∏ℓ Rℓ(g), log R = Σℓ log Rℓ, the variances added; a scenario sums the layers it stacks; the index is the mean of the gauge logarithms, its 95% interval under two bounds (the gauges independent; perfectly correlated); by the index's rule only what held the same way in all three of our runs enters, with every interval carried everything measured enters with its interval
